source_verification.method: direct official source page read before PREPARED and again after publication
observations: The official Met Office page resolved with the exact title and a readable full explainer body.
The body directly described chaotic weather, increasing longer-range uncertainty, the weakness of a one-off model run, and ensemble simulations with slightly different starting conditions.
The body directly connected the spread of scenarios to forecast confidence and careful language.
The same official page, exact title and substantive body remained readable after publication.
scope_caveats: The page does not display a clear original publication date, so none was invented.
The UK and North Atlantic discussion is regional and was not generalized to every location or forecast horizon.
Linked YouTube series and China-local video playback were not tested.
Estimated reading time and difficulty are teaching judgments.
The notes summarize and transform the source through original exercises; they do not reproduce the article at length.
source_verification.accessibility_at_check: official page text readable before and after publication; linked playback untested

teaching_qa.copyright_scope: links, concise summary, original exercises; no long article, transcript, dialogue or lyric reproduction
